lines.text: Many learners say: I will go to home.
Do not use to before home.
Home! I want to go home now.

data.why: Do not use to before home.

native.tip: home 앞에는 to를 쓰지 않아요. “I will go home”이 맞아요.

en.tip: Do not put “to” before home. “I will go home” is right.
en.caption: Do you say “I will go to home”? 🙈 You do not need “to” before home. “I will go home” sounds natural. Repeat with Ama! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
